whatWeDeliverData.heading: What our organization design consulting delivers.
whatWeDeliverData.description: One connected program, from strategy to a running operating model. Not a deck and a hand-off: at each step we show what we do, what we build with you, and the deliverable you keep, layer by layer.

methodData.heading: The Edstellar 5A organization design methodology.
methodData.subheading: Our five-step organization design method, from business strategy to a running, measured operating model.

steps.title: Assess

steps.description: Architect the target operating model, structure, roles and decision rights that close the priority gaps.

steps.title: Activate
steps.description: Implement the redesign: restructure, define roles and embed the new decision rights across teams.

steps.description: Measure, govern and renew each cycle, so the operating model keeps adapting rather than resetting.

whyCtaData.heading: Ready for organization design your strategy can run on?

items.question: What does organization design consulting include?
items.answer: It covers your target operating model, organizational structure and reporting lines, job architecture, role and accountability design, decision rights, and the governance and metrics that run it, all aligned to the business plan.

items.question: How is organization design different from a reorganization?
items.answer: A reorganization moves boxes on a chart. Organization design starts from the strategy and redesigns the operating model, roles and decision rights around it, so the organizational structure delivers the plan and lifts organizational effectiveness.

items.question: How long does an organization design engagement take?
items.answer: Typically four to eight weeks for the design and target operating model, depending on organization size and how many roles are in scope.

items.question: Do you help implement the redesign, not just design it?
items.answer: Yes. Restructuring, role definition and the change to embed new decision rights are a core part of the engagement, so the design becomes how the organization actually runs.

items.question: What do we get at the end?
items.answer: A target operating model, a structure and role design, a decision-rights map, a 12 to 24 month roadmap and the governance and health metrics you own and run.
